Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
 Order

This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.262/2011 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Nizamuddin, South East District, on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes vide a settlement which is on record of this Court.

2. Petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 who are present in Court and are duly identified by their counsels and the IO, had got married on 13.11.2020 but due to differences have now been divorced by way of a decree dated 20.09.2017.
Petitioner No.2 - 6 and the family members of petitioner No.1 are exempted from appearance.
3. Respondent No.2 confirms that all amounts due to her as per the settlement has been paid to her and nothing further is due.

4. Considering the above settlement between the parties and chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use to continue with proceedings of the present FIR as the complainant has settled all disputes with the petitioner.

Consequently, the FIR No.262/2011 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Nizamuddin,
South East District, and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
5. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.
Pending applications, if any, are disposed of as infructuous.
